subject: Minor cleanup remove unnecessary cast since slot is int (#1865)
reason: The change deletes a no-op (int) cast on a variable that is already an int in an addReplyErrorFormat call in checkSlotAssignmentsOrReply (src/cluster_legacy.c). The format string, argument value, and resulting error reply are identical on both builds, so there is no behaviour to exercise or compare; this is a pure cosmetic refactor that needs no scenario.
